_comment: The Ship Designer (wire id 3), work order 185. Geometry is screens/ship_design/sdgeom.py (transcribed from design_main.cpp); every label is HESTRNGS by the original's own id, every name TECHNAME's, every number open fix 44's DSGN block. The words here are OrionLayer's own where the original paints its words into DESIGN.LBX art (decision 15), and the marks name every difference from the original, each held by the ship_design smoke group and named in dev:v3_projektstatus.md.

words._note: DEVIATION `button_words`: the original's Clear, Cancel and Build carry their words in DESIGN.LBX's button art (entries 3-5), its title in the background (entry 0); HD draws them in code. The title's word is the one the art shows (HD EXTENSION `title`); no string table carries it.
words.title: Ship Design

marks.deviation_hud_frameless: The page wears the HUD's glass panels and buttons (decision 71) where the original wears DESIGN.LBX's background and button art; every position is the original's page.
marks.deviation_button_words: Clear, Cancel, Build, the icon arrows and plus / minus are drawn as HUD buttons with their words in code; the original paints the words into DESIGN.LBX's button art.
marks.hd_extension_title: The title plate; the original paints its headline into DESIGN.LBX's background, and no string table carries the word.
marks.omission_hover_messages: Over an empty weapon or special row the original prints 'Add New Weapon' or why none can be added; which of the three it is needs Space_For_Weapon_Replacement_, not on the wire. Not drawn.
marks.omission_flashing_hover: The original flashes a hovered row and the shield / computer name in a cycling palette index (Set_Flashing_Colors_); an RGB surface has none. Not drawn.
marks.deviation_row_help: A right click on a loaded weapon or special row opens the original's description of that item (Text_Box_ with the item's help record, found through its tech application); that id is not on the wire, so HD opens nothing there — the table's own help region begins below the loaded rows, as Set_Design_Screen_Help_List_ moves it.
marks.deviation_name_field: The name is edited in HD's own text field (glass, a proportional font, a bar caret) where the original prints it in its style-4 font with its own cursor; HD holds the text and the engine receives it on Enter — an injected click on the field, 15 Backspaces (the field is already open, so one takes one letter; fields.cpp:1181-1199), the keys one per tick, Enter (screens/ship_design/sdname.py, the save dialog's path). ESC cancels in HD, nothing sent. A click away from the open field commits it, as the original's does, and is not passed on. Nothing of the original's picture is shown.
